articles.title: Bitcoin think tank questions MSCI’s ‘invisible committee’ over Strategy, Metaplanet rule
articles.snippet: A Bitcoin Policy Institute paper says MSCI’s proposed “non-operating company” rule could remove Strategy and Metaplanet from its indexes and may have roots in an earlier crypto treasury review.

articles.title: Crypto advocacy group announces picks for US Congress as midterms loom
articles.snippet: The organization’s endorsements in the House and Senate came as many polls showed Democrats favored to regain control of both chambers in 2027.
